column3: Close to the Hebrew; כּוּשׁ (“Cush”) is rendered “Ethiopia,” and NKJV adds the parenthesis marks around the explanatory clause.
The rare material terms are rendered with interpretive names (“alabaster, turquoise, and white and black marble”); the identifications are uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “according to the hand of the king” is rendered “according to the generosity of the king.”
Close to the Hebrew; “every chief of his house” is rendered “all the officers of his household.”
Close to the Hebrew; “as enough of contempt and wrath” is rendered “excessive contempt and wrath.”
